en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a stair hall with a straight staircase and metal railings leading to an upper floor. The walls are lined with framed portrait photographs of various people. At the bottom right there are two upholstered armchairs and a small round wooden table. The style suggests a museum or institutional building. There is printed caption text along the bottom edge and a handwritten-style photographer's signature in the lower right.
